subject: EU in-region-only processing — cross-border access & deletion evidence
messages:
From: Julia Weber <julia.weber@biohealth.de>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: BioHealth GDPR <gdpr@biohealth.de>
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:03:00 +0200
Subject: Request: EU-only processing, cross-border access & deletion evidence

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team found Redwood's latency and batching controls compelling. Before we proceed to procurement, our legal and data-protection teams have a few concrete asks to evaluate EU-only processing under Schrems II + SCCs:

1) Confirmation that BioHealth data (production PII) can be processed only in EU regions (no spillover to non-EU locations) and a clear list of regions/availability zones used.
2) A copy of the SCCs execution template you use and whether Redwood signs as a data processor or sub-processor.
3) Technical evidence of deletion requests: what logs or artifacts you can provide to prove a deletion of a customer dataset (including backups), including timestamps and the shape of proofs you can deliver.
4) KMS/Key residency — are keys customer-managed (BYOK) and located in-region?
5) Any exceptions (support access, debug sessions) that could result in data egress and the controls for those.

Could you share an evidence pack or schedule a short call with engineering/legal to walk through these? We aim to close our security review by end of next week.

Best,
Julia Weber
Head of Privacy, BioHealth GmbH

From: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
To: Julia Weber <julia.weber@biohealth.de>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 11:18:00 +02:00
Subject: Re: Request: EU-only processing, cross-border access & deletion evidence

Julia — thanks for the clear list. We're aligned on urgency and can provide an evidence pack and a short walkthrough. High level answers below; I will loop in our infra and legal engineers for detail and artifacts.

- In-region processing: Redwood supports dedicated in-region processing. For BioHealth we can pin processing to the eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 regions only; we will confirm AZs in the pack.
- SCCs: Redwood executes SCCs with customers; legal signs as data processor. I will attach our standard SCCs template and a draft signature flow for you.
- Deletion evidence: we provide deletion runbooks, audit logs (request id + timestamp), and a signed attestation when requested — details and sample artifacts attached.
- KMS: BYOK supported; keys can be provisioned in your cloud KMS in-region. If you need Redwood-managed keys, we can confirm key residency and key-wrapping logs in the pack.
- Exceptions: support/debug sessions are controlled via jumpbox access with recorded session logs and require customer approval for any off-region access; exceptions are rare and documented.

I propose a 30-minute call Friday (22 Jun) 14:00 CEST to walk through the artifacts. If that works, I'll invite the right folks.

Attachments: redwood_audit_pack_v1.zip (summary + artifacts), sccs_signature_draft.docx

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +44 7700 900000

- KMS: BYOK steps, key residency evidence, and any key-wrap logs. (Karthik/Neha)
- Support/debug access policy & recorded session evidence. (Mina)

Priority: we need sanitized sample artifacts we can share externally (remove any other customer identifiers). Target: consolidated pack by EOD 22 Jun so we can review before the call.

Thanks — Tessa

- KMS: BYOK supported; if you want Redwood-managed keys we will provide key-residency metadata.

Call: Confirming our walkthrough Friday 22 Jun at 14:00 CEST — minutes and any follow-ups will be shared after the call. If you'd prefer a DS/DocuSign flow for SCCs, here is a link: https://docusign.com/embedded/sign/AAAbbbCCC123
